Marissa / team —

I pulled together the initial evidence list and redaction guidance. ETA for assembly: EOD Mon 2026-02-16. High-level list below (I’ll populate evidence_manifest.csv with file-level names):

Evidence checklist (examples):
- SOC2 report (redacted) — redaction needed for customer-specific data and internal IP: owner: Legal (request redaction)
- Control narratives (access control, change management) — owner: Vivek
- Architecture diagram (v1) — owner: Dev
- IAM configuration exports & screenshots (roles, policies, MFA) — owner: Dev/SRE
- Encryption config screenshots (KMS key usage, rotation policy) — owner: Vivek
- Audit log samples (anonymized) — owner: SRE (note: need to scrub PII)
- Pen test summary (if available) — owner: Security Ops
- Signed data processing addendum (if requested by procurement) — owner: Legal/Contracts

Redaction rules / blockers:
- We cannot share raw customer data or full unredacted logs. Any logs or screenshots with customer identifiers must be sanitized. Legal needs 24-48 hours to review redactions.
- If Aurelia needs unredacted items for a specific test, we need an explicit NDA/scoped access.

Risks / dependencies: 
- Legal redaction turnaround (24-48h)
- SRE availability for log exports
- Confirmation of the exact list Aurelia wants (full report vs. excerpts) — Sam to confirm

I’ll update the evidence_manifest.csv with precise filenames by Mon EOD and hand off the ZIP for delivery.

Vivek Kulkarni
